author: althoufx
text:
just one more opinion: points of view on that IF trade totally depend on the Time Frame.

An FO isn't forever, specially a LTF FO. I think IF gave a LTF
reading, where he catched the detail of separated PAZ and FO in between,
 and where he was interested in shorting just the price fall through CP
below, and not further, because he knew perfectly that FO would have had
 LTF effects (remember his goal to take few tent of pips per day...). It
 just was a little opportunity, as IF said he uses to trade.

by Higher TF it's evident the main signal was the bullish EG of FL

so that trade was, i think, simply amazing because it was a little short
 taken after HTF bullish signal, with awareness the FO was only visible
 at LLTF, then the short would have taken few pips. IF was sure it would
 have done as it did !!

Perhaps he took that trade because he just opened that chart, heaving
few minutes he readed the price (good weather...first life, second
money...) and decided to grab the pips available at the moment (not
greedy....).

nothing more...

At HTF there aren't FO

compression, but it can be considered stacked demand/supply...

When dealing with SPAZ it is good to be sure nothing is in the way (look left) once price breaks in.
